## History

Minnie May contracted a severe case of croup while [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde were away attending a political rally. Her sister, [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), desperately sought help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), prompting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to treat Minnie May throughout the night. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully nursed her back to health, which earned the gratitude of Minnie May's mother and restored the friendship between [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved Minnie May's life when the younger girl was afflicted with a severe case of croup. Desperate for help while the adults were away at a political rally, [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to care for her sister. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated Minnie May throughout the night, which ultimately earned Mrs. Barry's deep gratitude and restored Anne's friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), +1 more_
